fields.title: Reliability aggregation
fields.finding: Only an intact-member compression hazard envelope is reported. Independence, compression m=10, load sharing and reference volume are hypothetical.
fields.proposed_fix: Calibrate failure mechanisms and common causes before assembling a hull probability; do not substitute either number for installed reliability.

claim: Only an intact-member compression hazard envelope is reported. Independence, compression m=10, load sharing and reference volume are hypothetical. | Reliability aggregation
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
